summary: Local snowboarder in his 30s triggered and was caught in a soft-slab avalanche (D2, 1.5-2.5 ft crown, ~150 ft wide, ~1,500 ft run) at 'The Banker' in East Waterfall Canyon near Ophir; struck a tree and was seriously injured; 36+ SAR volunteers and deputies responded; Mountain Blade Runner helicopter flew him to Telluride Airport, then a medical helicopter to St. Mary's Hospital.
location: The Banker, East Waterfall Canyon, near Ophir
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office, San Miguel County SAR
notes: Date is the Tuesday the CAIC report is filed on; call came in a little after 1pm. Sheriff Bill Masters quoted in the SO Facebook post.
